name: deck
description: A pane beside the conversation for the work behind it: running shells and agents, the model and a clickable effort meter, and step-by-step progress of any job as a tree: /deck

hintLabel.title: Hint label
hintLabel.description: The label under the prompt: button (a row under the hint line you can press, where there is a pointer; text elsewhere), text (always at the end of the hint line) or off

modelTool.title: Tool for Claude
modelTool.description: Lets Claude show a job with levels as a progress tree, with two tools: plan and step

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Tells you with a toast when a background job fails or ends after half a minute, when a step fails and when a run finishes

transcriptRows.title: Transcript rows
transcriptRows.description: Under the transcript's line for a group of tool calls, a row for each shell command: its mark, what it does and how long it ran
